tbesh_html:
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.21;
son of: Laadah (H3935)
§ Mareshah = "crest of a hill"
one of the cities in the lowlands of Judah

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: or מַרֵשָׁה; formed like H4761 (מַרְאָשָׁה); summit;
